title: blaeria filago subsp. saxicola
intro: Blaeria filago subsp. saxicola, commonly known as alpine sea-blite, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. Alpine sea-blite has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of alpine sea-blite include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
